label: the ingest lock no longer stops a second ingest
an ingest lock without a pid is treated as stale and stolen
a live ingest owner is reclaimed instead of respected
old: kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null && return 1       # live owner: never stolen from
new: false                                        # live owner: never stolen from

label: a dead ingest owner's lock is never reclaimed
the no-pid case no longer creates the ownerless lock it claims to test
old: mkdir -p "$T/state/nas/.ingest.lock"     # the mkdir->pid window: the owner is unknown, not provably stale
new: :                                       # the mkdir->pid window: the owner is unknown, not provably stale
